title: Page 8
content_zh:
代替她，让关舜华流产，让关家人不好过，大概就是她这枚棋子最后的用处了吧……

萧王侧妃香消玉殒，宴会以血腹结束。

关舜华哭得泪人似的。

送走宾客后，关义成脸色沉郁得几乎快要化成实质滴下来。

而关舜华出事的时候，柳悠悠正陪在关夫人身边，这让她根本没有机会阻止，令她十分懊恼。

一切都是萧王设计好的，毁了面容的萧王再不遮掩自己的暴戾。

一个人突遭萧王这样的际遇，会性情大变大家倒也不是不能理解，可是萧王的身分让他做岀的事情杀伤力太大，这却是大家无法承受的。

关家人尤其难以承受。

关舜华边哭边自责，如果她足够小心，就不会发生这样的事。

张弘毅心头黯然，失去了夫妻两个期盼的小生命，他心中当然也是极度愤怒的，但是他不能埋怨妻子，因为这明显就是个要让他们夫妻失和的圈套，而且妻子现在这样的伤难过，他除了安抚还是安抚。

他不能在失去孩子之后，再让妻子也陷在痛苦之中走不出来。

「怨我，都怨我……」关舜华伏在他怀中痛哭。

「不怪你，不怪你，我们还年轻，孩子还会再有的，华儿，真的不怪你……」

张弘毅只能这样重复地安慰妻子。

关夫人在一旁跟着落泪，柳悠悠默然地陪着，心情也很是复杂。

他们谁都没有料到萧王会丧心病狂至此，他这真的是疯了吧？拿侧妃的一条命换关舜华肚子里孩子的一条命，以血腥堵住悠悠之口，却也让人心生寒意。

这时小荷端着一碗药从屋外进来。

在小荷走近床边，要把托盘朝张弘毅递过去时，柳悠悠注意到她右手异样的举动，疾呼了声「小心」，同时，她也有了行动。

因为她的呼声，张弘毅迟疑了下，匕首擦着张弘毅的左手臂而过，棉袍瞬间传染上了血色，而小荷已经来不及第二刺就已经被柳悠悠阻挡住了攻势。

她当然不可能是小荷，她只是化妆成了小荷的样子罢了，小荷的尸体在花园一角被人找到。

整个相府变得人心惶惶，京兆府很快也有人赶了讨来，展开调查。

关义成和唐忠信心里都十分清楚，只怕最终很可能什么也查不岀来。

刺客明显是一个死士，不成功便成仁，也不可能留下什么线索让他们来找岀幕后指使的元凶祸首，虽然，他们心里都很清楚幕后黑手是谁。

明知凶手身分却没有确凿证据能让他受到制裁，这真是让人无比恼怒的一件事。

对于义女身负武功一事，关义成并不太惊讶，边关长大的女子，有些功夫傍身是很正常的。

做为关府名义上的大小姐，柳悠悠和丈夫当夜便留宿了下来，帮着伤心过度身体不适的关夫人暂时打理府中事务。

这对一个已经成为当家主母的柳悠悠来说实在不是什么难事。

但是，今天相府里发生了太多的事，这让她不得不提高了警惕，留了心仔细排查府中之人。

萧王如今这样肆无忌惮地犯案，实在是让人毛骨悚然。

刺客的匕首上甚至还抹了毒，为了解毒，关义行不得不入宫冋皇帝借用御医，老御医险险抢回了张弘毅一命，让众人庆幸柳悠悠机警，发觉了不对劲，否则要是晩上一步，刺中要害，那真是神仙地难救。

关舜华小产，卧床；关夫人心疼爱女，本只是些微不适，又得知女婿差点死去，心中更是不安，还是病倒了；张弘毅为救妻负伤，差点儿命丧黄泉。

种种打击让关义成仿佛一夜之间就苍老了许多。

柳悠悠于是打算多留几日，照看着这一家子的老弱伤残。

唐忠信没有留下来陪妻子，他有更重要的事要去做。

他必须想办法拿下萧王，不能再允许他这样逍遥法外，惹是生非下去，否则天知道还会有什么样的事情发生！

第10章(1)

半个月后。

在关舜华的情绪终于从丧子之痛中缓过来，而关夫人的身体也渐渐康复的时候，柳悠悠终于能够自相府杂事中脱身，回自己的家去了。

天气很冷，可是马车里却很暖和。

车子里提前用炭盆烤过，暖呼呼的，她抱着一只手炉，靠坐在马车里不久就有了几丝睡意。

然而多年的密探生涯让她时时戒备，听到了马车外异常的声响，瞬间清醒过来，及时地避开了那一把刺入马车的长剑。

因下雪而行人稀落寂静的街道上，在这一刻突然变得喧闹起来，二十几个披着雪色斗篷隐藏在雪景中的刺客骤然暴起攻击，让只有三五个家仆随行的柳悠悠的生命安全一下子变得岌岌可危。

双拳难敌四手，几个家仆很快便命丧刀剑之下，而柳悠悠负了伤。

小果被勒令躲在马车之内不敢露头，整个人害怕得抖如筛糠。

当一柄长剑贯穿柳悠悠的左肩，随着长剑的抽离鲜血如血箭一般喷岀，柳悠悠的身形不禁晃了晃。

「小悠——」

一声夹杂着惊恐与怒意的男人声音传来，随即一群人迅速加入了战斗。

伸手扶住妻子有些虚脱的身子，唐忠信目訾尽裂。

萧王简直是太过无法无天了，这样的青天白日，就明晃晃地进行这么明目张胆的刺杀，他到底哪里来的信心这般有恃无恐？

在所有刺客伏诛之后，唐忠信一把抱起妻子，转身大步离开。

萧王完全疯了，死的刺客之中赫然有王府侍卫在内，他这是全然不把王法放在眼里，认定没有人能制裁他是吧。

一脸阻沉的唐忠信抱着妻子回到家中。

他亲手替妻子凊理了伤口，包扎好，狠狠地磨着牙低声道：「我不会放过他的。」

柳悠悠伸手安抚地握住了他的手，没说什么。

对于这样的无妄之灾，柳悠悠委实不知道自己能说些什么，只觉得莫名其妙地她就成了萧王的目标，莫名其妙就被他非要置于死地不可。

已经失去理智的人，想法真是难以理解。

喝了小苹端来的药汤后，柳悠悠很快便有些困倦。

「睡吧，我陪着你。」唐忠信在她耳边这样轻声说着。

柳悠悠没多久便睡着了。

可唐忠信并没有真的留下来陪她，因为手下传来更让人瞠目结舌的消息，他只能急匆匆地离府。

萧王率人夺宫！

这完全是一个疯子才能做出来的事啊。

不管不顾地针对当朝丞相，然后又莫名其妙地伏击他的妻子，最后干脆直接杀进宫门，这是最后的疯狂？还是要自我毁灭？

唐忠信不懂，许多人都和他一样不懂。

经历一场厮杀，萧王引起的宫变很快就被镇压，与他同盟者全都下狱，萧王也被囚于天牢。

私通契国、结党营私、图谋诰反的萧王很快就被宫中赐了鸩酒。

临死前，萧王给了大家答案，他说他恨丞相，如果不是关义成，他当年不会与储君之位失之交臂，所以他要报复，他要让关义成失去他所重视的一切。

可惜，他没能成功构陷关义成，没能一举将关舜华击杀，最后甚至连关义成的义女都没能杀死，他说他恨，恨为什么一切都被皇上夺走，他要拿回属于他的一切，不与他同盟，碍事的绊脚石统统都要被铲除。

唐忠信直接骂了他一句疯子。

新的一年便在萧王伏法后到来，但萧干带给一些人的阴影恐怕却不是一时半刻便能消退。

因为肩有伤，这个新年柳悠悠过得也并不算舒坦，但她的心境却还是很平和。
content_en:
Taking her place, causing Guan Shunhua to have a miscarriage and making life difficult for the Guan family, this is probably the final use of her chess piece...

Prince Xiao's side concubine died, and the banquet ended with a bloody belly.

Guan Shunhua burst into tears.

After seeing off the guests, Guan Yicheng's face was so gloomy that it almost turned into substance and dripped.

When Guan Shunhua's accident happened, Liu Youyou was with Mrs. Guan, which gave her no chance to stop it, which made her very upset.

Everything was planned by King Xiao, and King Xiao, whose face was ruined, could no longer hide his violence.

It's not impossible for everyone to understand that a person's temperament would change drastically when he suddenly encounters a situation like that of Prince Xiao. However, Prince Xiao's identity makes him do things that are too destructive, which is something that no one can bear.

The Guan family is particularly unbearable.

Guan Shunhua cried and blamed herself. If she was careful enough, such a thing would not happen.

Zhang Hongyi was devastated. He had lost the little life he and his wife had longed for. Of course, he was extremely angry, but he couldn't blame his wife, because this was obviously a trap to make them discord. Moreover, his wife was so sad now, so he couldn't do anything but comfort her.

He couldn't let his wife be trapped in pain after losing her child.

"Blame me, blame me..." Guan Shunhua cried bitterly in his arms.

"I don't blame you, I don't blame you. We are still young and we will have children again. Hua'er, I really don't blame you..."

Zhang Hongyi could only comfort his wife repeatedly.

Mrs. Guan cried beside her, Liu Youyou accompanied her silently, and her mood was very complicated.

None of them expected that King Xiao would become so mad. Is he really crazy?Trading the life of the concubine for the life of the child in Guan Shunhua's belly, blocking Youyou's mouth with blood, is also chilling.

At this time, Xiaohe came in from outside the house with a bowl of medicine.

When Xiao He approached the bed and was about to pass the tray to Zhang Hongyi, Liu Youyou noticed the strange movement of her right hand and shouted "Be careful". At the same time, she also took action.

Because of her cry, Zhang Hongyi hesitated for a moment, and the dagger grazed Zhang Hongyi's left arm. The cotton robe was instantly infected with blood, but Xiao He had no time to stab her again before Liu Youyou blocked the attack.

Of course she couldn't be Xiao He, she just made up to look like Xiao He. Xiao He's body was found in a corner of the garden.

The entire Prime Minister's Mansion became panic-stricken, and people from Jingzhao Mansion soon came to investigate.

Both Guan Yicheng and Tang Zhongxin knew very well that they might not be able to find anything in the end.

The assassin was obviously a dead man who would die if he didn't succeed, and it was impossible for them to leave any clues for them to find the culprit behind the scenes, although they knew very well who was behind the scenes.

It is extremely annoying to know the identity of the murderer but have no conclusive evidence to bring him to justice.

Guan Yicheng was not too surprised that his adopted daughter had martial arts skills. It was normal for a woman who grew up in the border area to have some martial arts skills.

As the nominal eldest lady of the Guan Mansion, Liu Youyou and her husband stayed overnight to help Mrs. Guan, who was extremely sad and unwell, temporarily take care of the affairs of the Mansion.

This is really not a difficult task for Liu Youyou, who has become the head matron of the house.

However, too many things happened in the prime minister's mansion today, which forced her to be more vigilant and carefully investigate the people in the mansion.

It's really horrifying that King Xiao is committing crimes so brazenly.

The assassin's dagger was even smeared with poison. In order to detoxify, Guan Yixing had to go to the palace and ask the emperor to borrow the imperial doctor. The old imperial doctor narrowly saved Zhang Hongyi's life. Everyone was thankful that Liu Youyou was alert and noticed something was wrong. Otherwise, if he had taken a step late and stabbed the vital part, it would have been really difficult to save him.

Guan Shunhua had a miscarriage and was bedridden; Mrs. Guan was distressed about her beloved daughter and was only slightly unwell. When she learned that her son-in-law had almost died, she became even more uneasy and fell ill; Zhang Hongyi was injured while trying to save his wife and almost died.

All kinds of blows made Guan Yicheng seem to have aged a lot overnight.

Liu Youyou then planned to stay for a few more days to take care of the old, weak and disabled in the family.

Tang Zhongxin did not stay with his wife, he had more important things to do.

He must find a way to take down King Xiao. He can no longer be allowed to get away with it and cause trouble, otherwise God knows what else will happen!

Chapter 10(1)

Half a month later.

When Guan Shunhua finally recovered from the pain of losing his son, and Mrs. Guan's body gradually recovered, Liu Youyou was finally able to get away from the chores in the Prime Minister's Mansion and return to her home.

The weather was cold, but the carriage was warm.

The car had been roasted in a charcoal pot in advance, and it was warm. She hugged a hand stove and sat back in the carriage, and soon she felt a little sleepy.

However, many years of being a secret agent made her always on guard. When she heard an unusual noise outside the carriage, she woke up instantly and avoided the long sword that pierced the carriage in time.

The streets, which were deserted and quiet due to the snow, suddenly became noisy at this moment. More than twenty assassins wearing snow-colored cloaks hidden in the snowy scenery suddenly attacked, making the life of Liu Youyou, who was accompanied by only three or five servants, suddenly in danger.

Two fists were no match for four hands, and several servants were soon killed by the sword, while Liu Youyou was injured.

Xiaoguo was ordered to hide in the carriage and not dare to show her head. She was so scared that she was shaking like chaff.

When a long sword penetrated Liu Youyou's left shoulder, and blood spurted out like a blood arrow as the sword was withdrawn, Liu Youyou's figure couldn't help but swayed.

"Xiao Yu—"

A man's voice sounded mixed with fear and anger, and then a group of people quickly joined the battle.

Tang Zhongxin stretched out his hand to support his wife's somewhat exhausted body. His eyes were filled with tears.

King Xiao was simply too lawless. He carried out such a blatant assassination in broad daylight. Where did he get the confidence to be so fearless?

After all the assassins were killed, Tang Zhongxin picked up his wife, turned around and strode away.

King Xiao was completely crazy. Among the assassins who died were the palace guards. He didn't take Wang Fa seriously at all, and he believed that no one could punish him, right?

Tang Zhongxin, with a stern look on his face, returned home with his wife in his arms.

He took care of his wife's wound with his own hands, bandaged it, and gritted his teeth in a low voice, "I won't let him go."

Liu Youyou reached out and held his hand comfortingly without saying anything.

Regarding such an unreasonable disaster, Liu Youyou really didn't know what she could say. She just felt that she had become King Xiao's target for some reason, and that he had to put her to death for no reason.

The thoughts of people who have lost their minds are really difficult to understand.

After drinking the medicinal soup brought by Xiao Ping, Liu Youyou soon became sleepy.

"Go to sleep, I'll stay with you." Tang Zhongxin whispered in her ear.

Liu Youyou fell asleep not long after.

But Tang Zhongxin didn't really stay with her, because even more shocking news came from his subordinates, so he could only leave the house in a hurry.

King Xiao led his men to seize the palace!

This is something only a madman can do.

He recklessly targeted the prime minister of the dynasty, then ambushed his wife inexplicably, and finally stormed directly into the palace gate. Is this the final madness?Or self-destruction?

Tang Zhongxin didn't understand, and many people didn't understand like him.

After a fight, the palace rebellion caused by King Xiao was quickly suppressed. All his allies were imprisoned, and King Xiao was also imprisoned in the sky prison.

King Xiao, who had liaison with the country, formed a party for personal gain, and plotted rebellion, was soon given poisonous wine by the palace.

Before he died, King Xiao gave everyone the answer. He said that he hated the prime minister. If it weren't for Guan Yicheng, he would not have missed out on the position of prince, so he wanted revenge. He wanted Guan Yicheng to lose everything he valued.

It's a pity that he failed to frame Guan Yicheng, failed to kill Guan Shunhua in one fell swoop, and in the end even failed to kill Guan Yicheng's adopted daughter. He said that he hated and hated why everything was taken away by the emperor. He wanted to get back everything that belonged to him. If he did not ally with him, all the stumbling blocks in the way would be eradicated.

Tang Zhongxin directly called him crazy.

The new year has arrived after King Xiao's death, but the shadow that Xiao Qian brought to some people may not fade away in a short time.

Because of her shoulder injury, Liu Youyou did not have a comfortable life this New Year, but her mood was still very peaceful.
